unit.titleZh: 想参加，也有一点儿犹豫

Present two sides with 一方面…另一方面

grammar.explanation: 一会儿想去，一会儿又想休息 describes an alternation, not simultaneous action. It is different from 一会儿以后 which says later. The actual duration of each spell need not be fixed.

examples.zh: 她一会儿想去，一会儿又想休息。
examples.py: tā yī huì er xiǎng qù , yī huì er yòu xiǎng xiū xī .
examples.en: She alternates between wanting to go and wanting to rest.

examples.zh: 声音一会儿大，一会儿小。
examples.py: shēng yīn yī huì er dà , yī huì er xiǎo .
examples.en: The sound alternates between loud and quiet.

examples.py: wǒ yī huì er dú , yī huì er tīng .
examples.en: I alternate between reading and listening.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一会儿读，一会儿听就是同时读听。
commonMistakes.right: 一会儿读，一会儿听是交替，不一定同时。

grammar.purpose: Organize two sides of a decision
grammar.explanation: The pattern frames distinct considerations, not necessarily equal weights or opposite opinions. 一方面想参加，另一方面需要休息 does not itself announce a final decision. Hear the person’s decision separately.

examples.zh: 一方面想参加，另一方面需要休息。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn xiǎng cān jiā , lìng yì fāng miàn xū yào xiū xī .
examples.en: On one hand I want to join; on the other I need rest.

examples.zh: 一方面要看时间，另一方面要问主人。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn yào kàn shí jiān , lìng yì fāng miàn yào wèn zhǔ rén .
examples.en: One consideration is time; another is asking the host.

examples.zh: 一方面很期待，另一方面有点儿紧张。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn hěn qī dài , lìng yì fāng miàn yǒu diǎn ér jǐn zhāng .
examples.en: I am excited on one hand and a little nervous on the other.

commonMistakes.wrong: 说了两方面就已经决定参加。
commonMistakes.right: 说了两方面，还没说明最后决定。
commonMistakes.why: Presenting reasons does not establish a decision.

dialogue.title: Two feelings are both real
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what is decided and undecided.

lines.zh: 你一会儿想去，一会儿又想休息，最后决定了吗？
lines.py: nǐ yī huì er xiǎng qù , yī huì er yòu xiǎng xiū xī , zuì hòu jué dìng le ma ?
lines.en: You alternate between wanting to go and rest; have you decided?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没。一方面想深入了解，另一方面需要休息。
lines.py: hái méi . yì fāng miàn xiǎng shēn rù liǎo jiě , lìng yì fāng miàn xū yào xiū xī .
lines.en: Not yet. I want deeper understanding on one hand and need rest on the other.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 负责人是她，她任这个工作，但不能替你决定。
lines.py: fù zé rén shì tā , tā rèn zhè gè gōng zuò , dàn bù néng tì nǐ jué dìng .
lines.en: She is the leader and holds that role, but cannot decide for you.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。朋友支持让我觉得温暖，幸福也要听我自己说。
lines.py: duì . péng you zhī chí ràng wǒ jué de wēn nuǎn , xìng fú yě yào tīng wǒ zì jǐ shuō .
lines.en: Right. Friends’ support feels warm; happiness is something I describe myself.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 故事里的角色受伤还出血了，植物也有枯死的场景。
lines.py: gù shì lǐ de jué sè shòu shāng hái chū xiě le , zhí wù yě yǒu kū sǐ de chǎng jǐng .
lines.en: The story’s character is injured and bleeding, and a plant withers and dies.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那是故事。危险场景不能拿来当真实诊断，也别替别人猜。
lines.py: nà shì gù shì . wēi xiǎn chǎng jǐng bù néng ná lái dàng zhēn shí zhěn duàn , yě bié tì bié ren cāi .
lines.en: That is a story. A dangerous scene is not real diagnosis; do not guess for others.
lines.speaker: b

choices: It makes every decision for them

questions.q: Does the leader decide for the speaker?

reading.title: Reasons before a decision
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 这次对话印象深刻，头脑里仍有两个想法，不是乱猜。
lines.py: zhè cì duì huà yìn xiàng shēn kè , tóu nǎo lǐ réng yǒu liǎng gè xiǎng fǎ , bù shì luàn cāi .
lines.en: The conversation left a deep impression; two ideas remain in mind, rather than random guesses.

lines.zh: 一方面受到支持，另一方面想慢慢观察；退一步不是拒绝。
lines.py: yì fāng miàn shòu dào zhī chí , lìng yì fāng miàn xiǎng màn màn guān chá ; tuì yī bù bù shì jù jué .
lines.en: There is support on one side and a wish to observe slowly on the other; stepping back is not rejection.

lines.zh: 要退出活动就告诉负责人，以前的记录保留，不假装没发生。
lines.py: yào tuì chū huó dòng jiù gào sù fù zé rén , yǐ qián de jì lù bǎo liú , bù jiǎ zhuāng méi fā shēng .
lines.en: Tell the leader when withdrawing; preserve prior records rather than pretend they never happened.

lines.zh: 卡片上的福表达祝愿，幸运也不是下一次结果的保证。
lines.py: kǎ piàn shàng de fú biǎo dá zhù yuàn , xìng yùn yě bù shì xià yī cì jié guǒ de bǎo zhèng .
lines.en: 福 on the card expresses a wish; good fortune does not guarantee the next outcome.

lines.zh: 故事里土很深，种子慢慢生长，植物生存需要条件；生命不能只用照片判断。
lines.py: gù shì lǐ tǔ hěn shēn , zhǒng zi màn màn shēng zhǎng , zhí wù shēng cún xū yào tiáo jiàn ; shēng mìng bù néng zhǐ yòng zhào piān pàn duàn .
lines.en: In the story the soil is deep and seeds grow slowly; plant survival needs conditions; photographs alone do not determine life.

lines.zh: 生的材料和熟的菜不同；这里练的是语言，不给真实照顾或诊断的办法。
lines.py: shēng de cái liào hé shú de cài bù tóng ; zhè lǐ liàn de shì yǔ yán , bù gěi zhēn shí zhào gù huò zhěn duàn de bàn fǎ .
lines.en: Raw ingredients differ from cooked food; this is language practice, not actual care or diagnostic instruction.

questions.q: What does 福 on the card express?

choices: Reasons, feelings and the final decision
A blessing and a guaranteed result
A fictional story and a diagnosis treated as one
questions.answer: Reasons, feelings and the final decision

lines.zh: 卡片上的福表达祝愿，【幸运】也不是下一次结果的保证。
